projects.title: Linguae Legend
projects.subtitle: Rogue-like Wordle
projects.content: You awake in a mysterious world with swords, magic, monsters, and... words? This word guessing game adds twists to the classic formula with power-ups, tiles with special effects, and a (cringy) storyline, topped with a RPG fantasy theme inspired by Dark Souls.

projects.title: Con Grazia
projects.subtitle: Endless shoot 'em up
projects.content: Con Grazia is an arcade-style endless shooter game full of spell-slinging goodness and pesky slimes. Key features: slimes (comes in multiple flavours!), bigger slimes, cool wizard person.

projects.title: Mission Improbable
projects.subtitle: First-person shooter
projects.content: Welcome, Agent 008 (NOT 007). You are on a mission to defeat eeeeeevil alien robots in 5 unique and (very) challenging stages, with a hint of bullet hell ;). It's like frigid outskirts without the reindeers.

projects.title: Tributary
projects.subtitle: Event streaming library
projects.content: A distributed event streaming platform library and API inspired by Apache Kafka.

projects.title: xChange
projects.subtitle: UNSW exchange browser
projects.content: A browser and search filter for UNSW's exchange program offerings.

projects.title: Diviners' Gambit
projects.subtitle: Multiplayer card game
projects.content: Ever wanted to play rock-paper-scissors, but with over 70 different options? Based on a childhood game I used to play at school, this online multiplayer card game features intricate mind-games and strategies, character abilities, customisable card presets and game modes, and just pure chaotic fun!

projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.subtitle: Up-to-date project archive
projects.content: A collection of all the projects I've made (for Computer Science) and a timeline of my traumas (for Law).

projects.title: Toohak
projects.subtitle: Kahoot-like quiz
projects.content: Interactive quiz game inspired by Kahoot.

projects.title: Stranger Danger
projects.subtitle: Puzzle horror
projects.content: Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, one determined Survivor face a bloodthirsty Killer(s) in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Don't pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's worst symmetrical singleplayer.

projects.title: My Portfolio (Legacy)
projects.subtitle: Old project archive
projects.content: A collection of all the projects I've made.

projects.title: SpliceChat
projects.subtitle: Genetic variant analyser
projects.content: An LLM-powered assistant for evaluating candidate disease-causing splice-altering genetic variants. Completed in a team as my Bachelor of Computer Science degree's captone project at UNSW.

projects.title: The Diviners' Gambit
projects.subtitle: Web-based multiplayer card game
projects.content: Imagine rock-paper-scissors but now with over 100 options, a single-player rogue-like campaign, and multiplayer four-player lobbies all free in your browser! A comprehensive remake of the Unity version of Diviners' Gambit.

projects.title: Tom's Room
projects.subtitle: Study-timer, cosy animated scenery, rain garden
projects.content: I love procrastinating, so I made a study timer to force myself to lock in – would love for you to use it too! Study by some cosy animated scenery with gentle ambience, track your tasks with a todo list synced across desktop and mobile, and tend to the rain garden.
